limitations.message: No network request was made; endpoint posture is inferred from local configuration only.
Addresses, scripts, descriptors, xpubs, backend URLs/tokens, wallet config, raw_json, branch/index values, and derivation paths are omitted from this payload.

database_plaintext.title: Database file is plaintext SQLite
database_plaintext.detail: The active database header is plaintext SQLite; SQLCipher encryption is not active for this data root.
database_plaintext.recommendation: Use `kassiber secrets init` if this book should be encrypted at rest.

remote_backend_endpoints.title: Third-party backend endpoints are configured
remote_backend_endpoints.detail: {count} configured backend endpoint(s) are inferred as third-party and can observe wallet/indexer queries.
remote_backend_endpoints.recommendation: Use your own node/backend or a per-backend proxy when that exposure is not acceptable.

unacknowledged_off_device_ai_provider.title: Off-device AI provider needs acknowledgement
unacknowledged_off_device_ai_provider.detail: {count} off-device AI provider(s) lack an acknowledgement timestamp.
unacknowledged_off_device_ai_provider.recommendation: Review the provider posture before sending assistant prompts.

watch_only_wallet_material_present.title: Watch-only wallet material is stored locally
watch_only_wallet_material_present.detail: {count} wallet(s) have watch-only material in the local database.

privacy_boundary_transactions_present.title: Privacy-boundary transaction markers are present
privacy_boundary_transactions_present.detail: {count} transaction(s) carry a privacy-boundary marker; provenance across those hops remains opaque unless reviewed with stronger evidence.

import_raw_json_present.title: Imported raw metadata is present
import_raw_json_present.detail: {count} transaction(s) retain importer raw_json inside the local database; this payload reports only the count.

local_utxo_location_metadata_present.title: Local UTXO location metadata is present
local_utxo_location_metadata_present.detail: The local output inventory contains address, script, or derivation metadata; this payload reports counts only.

privacy_quarantines_present.title: Privacy-related journal quarantines are present
privacy_quarantines_present.detail: {count} journal quarantine(s) are privacy-related and need review before derived reports are complete.

database_encryption_unknown.title: Database encryption status is unknown
database_encryption_unknown.detail: Kassiber could not classify the active database header from the local file.

off_device_ai_provider_configured.title: Off-device AI providers are configured
off_device_ai_provider_configured.detail: {count} configured AI provider(s) may send prompt content outside this machine when selected.
off_device_ai_provider_configured.recommendation: Keep the assistant on a local provider for local-only inference.

queries.name: active_transactions
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM transactions WHERE profile_id = ? AND excluded = 0

queries.name: excluded_transactions
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM transactions WHERE profile_id = ? AND excluded != 0

queries.name: raw_json_transactions
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM transactions WHERE profile_id = ? AND raw_json IS NOT NULL AND trim(raw_json) NOT IN ('', '{}', 'null')

queries.name: privacy_boundary_transactions
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM transactions WHERE profile_id = ? AND privacy_boundary IS NOT NULL AND trim(privacy_boundary) != ''

queries.name: utxo_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM wallet_utxos WHERE profile_id = ?

queries.name: active_utxo_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM wallet_utxos WHERE profile_id = ? AND spent_at IS NULL

queries.name: utxos_with_address
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM wallet_utxos WHERE profile_id = ? AND address IS NOT NULL AND trim(address) != ''

queries.name: utxos_with_script
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM wallet_utxos WHERE profile_id = ? AND script_pubkey IS NOT NULL AND trim(script_pubkey) != ''

queries.name: utxos_with_derivation
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM wallet_utxos WHERE profile_id = ? AND (branch_index IS NOT NULL OR address_index IS NOT NULL)

queries.name: journal_entry_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM journal_entries WHERE profile_id = ?

queries.name: quarantine_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM journal_quarantines WHERE profile_id = ?

queries.name: privacy_quarantine_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM journal_quarantines WHERE profile_id = ? AND reason LIKE 'privacy%'
